_doc: Reference vectors of whole inputs holding an image, for the EmbeddingGemma 2 pipeline (generated by tools/export-recipes/embeddinggemma2/multimodal_reference.py).

Upstream: SentenceTransformer of the pinned snapshot, f32 on the CPU; each case is one `encode` call of an upstream dict input (its keys in the parts' order), with the prompt name when the case has one.

The tensors of multimodal-reference.safetensors: `image.<name>` U8 [height, width, 3] (row-major RGB8, what upstream's processor read), `<case>.input_ids` I32 [T] (the ids the composite model received, `<bos>` and `<eos>` included, each image as `<|image>` + n x `<|image|>` + `<image|>`), `<case>.embedding` F32 [768] (the normalised vector `encode` returned).
`composition` is Karume's two graphs composed in torch f32 (the tower wrapper's soft tokens at the image's placeholder rows of the text wrapper) against upstream's vector.
The images are synthetic and neutral (tools/export-recipes/embeddinggemma2/images.py); do not add others.

images.name: noise-tall
images.why: a tall aspect, every pixel independent

images.name: stripes-edge
images.why: the smallest soft-token count the resize rule produces (139, a rounding edge)

cases.name: text-then-image
cases.why: a text, then an image (a wide one)

parts.text: Flat coloured shapes on a light background

cases.name: image-then-text
cases.why: an image (a tall one), then a text

cases.name: query-text-image
cases.why: a text with a prompt's prefix, then an image (the prefix is glued to the first text run)

cases.name: two-images
cases.why: two images, one of the smallest soft-token count, with nothing between them
